newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Agreement reached on HK container terminal--Tsang.
newsitem.headline: Agreement reached on HK container terminal--Tsang.

text.p: The companies involved in Hong Kong's long-delayed Container Terminal Number Nine (CT9) project have agreed on a proposal which will be submitted to China for approval, Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said on Tuesday.
"The consortium has come to an agreement on how the various berths of the CT9 should be best utilised and we are discussing putting this proposal to the Chinese side," Tsang said.
"We hope to bring this matter to finality at the next Joint Liaison Group (JLG) meeting," he told reporters.
